en.askTitle: Put in your own two cities, ages and income and get the same visa, insurance and four-month budget comparison
en.runTitle: Busan to Chiang Mai or Da Nang: a retired couple’s four winter months on KRW 2.9 million a month

fields.label: Ages and nationality
fields.value: Two South Korean passport holders, aged 63 and 66

fields.label: Monthly pension income in KRW
fields.value: About KRW 2.9 million a month combined (National Pension plus a private annuity)

en.template: Help me choose between {citya} and {cityb} for {months} of winter away starting {start}. We are {who}, our monthly pension income is {income} and our savings are {savings}. Rebuild the visa routes for our passports, the four-month budget in KRW using my rent, food and insurance numbers, and the comparison with our income, keep every unconfirmed item marked, and check any insurer, landlord or agent quote I paste in. Ask before contacting anyone or paying anything.

phases.title: Read the official visa, insurance and pension pages, and collect dated rents and prices
phases.note: Thailand and Vietnam stay rules, Korean health insurance abroad, rent examples, air quality
phases.judgment: It would not present Thailand’s stay length for Koreans as settled. The newest official page it found predates the September 2026 rule change (60 days, extendable to 90), while other sources say 90 days. The guide shows both readings and says to confirm with the Thai embassy in Seoul.

phases.title: Write the guide and the source list
phases.note: Recommendation, visa comparison and four-month budgets in KRW

phases.title: Independent checks of every figure and claim, then fixes
phases.judgment: The independent colleagues re-did every sum and pushed back on wording the sources could not back up, such as “Da Nang avoids this risk”. After the fixes the cost line changed from “costs look similar” to Da Nang at KRW 11.0–11.4 million against Chiang Mai at KRW 12.2–12.5 million for four months. The last check still said “pass with issues”, and the leftovers are listed rather than hidden.

workers: Read the Thai and Vietnamese stay rules for Korean passports: visa exemption, long-stay visa options, extensions and arrival forms
Collected dated furnished-flat rents, exchange rates, Chiang Mai’s smoke season, flights and the Da Nang hospital page
Checked what Korean health insurance and the National Pension do during a long stay abroad, plus travel-insurance price examples for people in their 60s
First independent check: re-did every money figure and compared each claim with the source list
Second check after the first fixes: confirmed the earlier problems were fixed and looked for new ones
Final check of the finished page: re-ran the sums and listed what was still open
